title: Microsoft Purview: Azure PST Import to Exchange Online mailboxes
summary: The briefing matches the roadmap and Microsoft's supplied notice, including the April 2027 government-cloud target and the administrator-driven workflow. The role-assignment instructions and published licensing rights are supported. One minor correction should distinguish the existing import service's recommended 20 GB PST size from a hard limit.

claims.claim: Microsoft plans to import PST files directly from Azure Blob Storage into Exchange Online mailboxes.
claims.quote: Azure PST Import is a migration method that enables PST files stored in Azure Blob Storage to be imported directly into Exchange Online mailboxes.

claims.claim: The method follows a two-step Exchange Migration Service pattern of analysis followed by migration.
claims.quote: It follows the standard two‑step Exchange Migration Service pattern: an initial analysis phase to validate and assess PST data, followed by execution of the actual migration.

claims.claim: Existing Purview PST import turns on retention hold after import.

claims.claim: The existing import service's 20 GB PST file size guidance is described among its limits.
claims.quote: Upload or copy PST files that are no larger than 20 GB. Large PST files can affect the performance of the import process.
claims.fix: Replace 'Do the limits of the existing Purview PST import (for example 20 GB PST files, 150 MB items and 100 GB into an archive in one import) apply to Azure PST Import?' with 'Do the existing Purview PST import size guidance (PST files no larger than 20 GB) and limits (150 MB items and 100 GB into an archive in one import) apply to Azure PST Import?' This preserves the cited overview's distinction between file-size guidance and enforced limits.

claims.claim: The existing Purview PST import has a 150 MB item limit.
claims.quote: If a PST file contains a mailbox item that's larger than 150 MB, the import process skips the item and doesn't import it.

claims.claim: The existing Purview PST import cannot import more than 100 GB into a user's archive in a single import.
claims.quote: As a result, you can't import more than 100 GB of data into a user's archive in a single import.

claims.claim: The New-MigrationEndpoint reference does not tie its PSTImport parameter set to Azure Blob Storage.
claims.quote: Searched: PSTImport, Azure and Blob in the opened New-MigrationEndpoint reference. PSTImport is listed; Azure appears for cross-tenant Key Vault authentication, not a Blob Storage PST endpoint. No connection to the new workflow is documented.
